Data & sources

All values are read from the local game client's content tables (bin/*_table.bin, msgpack) and asset bundles. Account data is never read.

Column names come from the client's own row classes (e.g. class Stage_table { StageID; GroupID; … }) extracted from the running game; every field list matches its table's row width.

Combat formulas were copied from the client's own calcFinal_* functions after the game decrypted its script bundle in memory; no formula is guessed.

Game text uses the original English, Indonesian, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese localization. English is used when a translation is absent.

Item icons are matched to the exact sprite names in the item table. Game assets belong to their respective owners.
